subject: MAP Compass — evaluation playbook + slide seeds
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Compass — initial playbook + slides (seed)

Hi team,

I put together an initial 'MAP Compass' — a compact mutual action playbook and a two-slide seed deck that frames the evaluation flow and acceptance criteria for Brightline. The goal is a small, shareable GDoc we can hand to their stakeholders after the discovery call and a one-slide timeline they can paste into their roadmap.

What I'd like from you:
- Marissa: please add the technical checkpoints for week 1 and any infra gating steps.
- Ben: quick pricing placeholder (monthly usage / pilot cap) and an estimated ramp cadence.

Key sections in the doc (seed v0):
- Objective & success metrics
- Stakeholder lanes & approvals
- Week-by-week evaluation milestones (21-day pilot option included)
- Technical readiness checklist (kvs, network, data flows)
- Acceptance criteria & sample test cases

Attachments / links:
- MAP_Compass_v0.gdoc (Drive link included below)
- MAP_Compass_Slides_seed.pptx (1-slide timeline + 1-slide acceptance matrix)
- acceptance-checklist.xlsx (QA checklist stub)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFGH-map-compass-v0
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/brightline/record/BRIGHT-2026-043

Timeline: I'd like to share a first draft with Brightline during Monday's discovery follow-up (their timezone: ET). If we can finalize internal comments by EOD Monday PT, I can push a cleaned GDoc and slides to them Tuesday morning.

Thanks — sending as a seed so we can iterate quickly.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Compass — initial playbook + slides (seed)

On Fri, Sep 4, 2026 at 9:12 AM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi team,
> 
> I put together an initial 'MAP Compass' — a compact mutual action playbook and a two-slide seed deck ...

Thanks Chloe — nice shape. Quick notes inline and summary below. I added a short tech gating checklist to the Google Doc (see section 'Infra & gating') and a suggestion for a minimal smoke test we can ask Brightline to run in week 1 (3 example prompts + perf thresholds).

Summary of changes I propose before external share:
1) Tighten acceptance criteria — add explicit latency and token-cost ranges for the pilot.
2) Add 'data handling' quick bullets under stakeholder lanes (who accesses logs, retention windows).
3) Replace the generic '21-day pilot' timeline with two variants: Rapid 10-day validation and Standard 21-day pilot (callouts for resource needs).
4) Add an owner column to the milestone table so it's obvious who at Brightline and who at Redwood is responsible.

Ben — can you drop in a pricing ballpark (bullet, not legal) for a 21-day pilot with the expected token volumes? If you put ranges I can reference them in the doc.

I also left a comment suggesting we move the acceptance-checklist.xlsx into the GDoc as an embedded table (makes it easier for Brightline to edit).

Happy to hop on a quick 20m sync after lunch to reconcile.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

On Fri, Sep 4, 2026 at 12:40 PM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Chloe — nice shape. Quick notes inline and summary below...

Added a small pricing section (notes in the GDoc):
- Pilot pricing (21-day): $4,500 — includes 50k tokens/day baseline, overage billed at $0.03/1k tokens.
- Rapid validation (10-day): $2,000 flat (capped to 25k tokens/day).
- If Brightline wants a dedicated pool for the pilot we should treat that as a separate committed quote — I'll flag that as an optional addendum.

Also: I agree with Marissa on embedding the checklist. I uploaded a cleaned copy and moved the 3 smoke-test prompts into the 'Acceptance' section.

If you want me to, I can draft a short "pilot SOW" paragraph we can attach to the GDoc that spells out deliverables and a go/no-go decision gate.

—Ben
